finding.claim: A title with a line break splits the index entry over two lines, so kmctl check fails straight after kmctl new doc (and kmctl new KIND, which has the same gap).

fixes.change: New shared one_line and link_text helpers; kmctl new collapses a title's whitespace, line breaks included, so its index entry stays on one line.
new_doc uses the shared one_line and link_text helpers instead of its own copy, so a title with a line break stays one index line.
r1 asserts every skeleton heading per type; tests for line-break titles in kmctl new doc and kmctl new, each followed by kmctl check; and a test that the Next line names kmctl check.
